scope_description.value: New construction of an intermediate maintenance level composite repair shop for the CMV-22B aircraft at Naval Station Norfolk. Facility includes shops, administrative space, paint mixing room, paint booth space, hazardous material storage, and other support areas. Structure consists of reinforced concrete masonry unit (CMU) wall system with exterior split-faced CMU veneer, concrete pile foundation, and standing-seam metal roof system.
scope_description.source: RFP General Requirements, Description of the Work
scope_description.quote: P1127U Constructs an intermediate maintenance level composite repair shop for the CMV-22B aircraft. Facility will consist of a reinforced concrete masonry unit (CMU) wall system with an exterior split-faced CMU veneer, concrete plie foundation, interior walls of CMU and a standing-seam metal roof system. The facility includes shops, administrative space, paint mixing room, paint booth space, hazardous material storage, and other support areas.
